_comment: Wistia media hashed-IDs, grouped by the room key in screen.json.
Within a room the IDs are handed out in wall order (clockwise from the
Keyed by room rather than by flat screen index on purpose -- the screens are
numbered in map-emission order, which interleaves (the Lenny room owns
0-5 AND 13, because its last wall is emitted after the whole branch loop).
Each ID is resolved to a CORS-enabled MP4 at runtime via
https://fast.wistia.net/embed/medias/<id>.json -- IDs only, no URLs to rot.
A room listed in 'shuffle' is a POOL: it may hold more IDs than the room has
walls, and each page load draws a fresh random subset. Rooms not listed are
used in order and must match their wall count exactly -- 'team' is deliberately
NOT shuffled, so nobody's message can be dropped or reordered.
'labels' overrides the caption under the full-quality player. Unlabelled IDs
fall back to the Wistia title, which is what the Lenny pool wants.
